# sbx-browser

> Self-hosted orchestration for cloud coding agents: describe a task, and sbx-browser runs an official provider CLI (Codex, Devin, Antigravity, Grok, OpenCode) in an isolated Modal Sandbox behind one REST API.

Self-hosted under your own Modal workspace and your own provider subscriptions; not a hosted service.

## Getting started

- [Introduction](/getting-started/introduction/): what sbx-browser is and when to use it
- [Quick start](/getting-started/quick-start/): use an existing deployment or self-host, first task in ~10 minutes

## Guides

- [Tasks](/guides/tasks/): create, monitor, follow up, cancel and retry
- [Repositories & delivery](/guides/repositories/): revisions, branches, pull requests, review-gated merge
- [Console](/guides/console/): web console for tasks, review, accounts and keys
- [Accounts](/guides/accounts/): provider accounts, slots, failover
- [Streaming](/guides/streaming/): SSE events, Last-Event-ID resume
- [Structured output](/guides/structured-output/): JSON Schema contracts on run results
- [Agents and runs](/guides/agents-and-runs/): the lower-level surface under tasks
- [Workflows](/guides/workflows/): gated pipelines and recovery
- [Artifacts & handoffs](/guides/handoffs-and-artifacts/): checkpoints and cross-agent handoff
- [Resources & compute](/guides/resources-and-compute/): CPU/memory, secrets, MCP servers
